in_sanskrit.name: Samji
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Learned, Wise, Skilled
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Samji एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Sam (सम) means 'equal, same, calm, and learned' and Ji (जी) means 'born' or 'skilled'. Together, Samji can be interpreted as 'One who is born wise or learned' or 'One who is calm, equal, and skilled'.
